title: spaex Molecule Manifest v4
description: Schema for a per-molecule manifest.json. Delivered files are grouped by category in atoms; a molecule is not a composition list. Structurally identical to v3; only the version-field name (`haex_hive_version` -> `spaex_version`) and value (`3` -> `4`) change.

id.description: Reverse-DNS molecule-id. Must equal the publisher-root-manifest key that referenced this molecule.

version.description: Semver X.Y.Z. Must equal the version the publisher root manifest declared for this molecule-id.

priority.description: Publisher's default priority. Consumer configuration may override it.

atoms.description: Category names mapped to non-empty lists of molecule-directory-relative delivered files. Category keys are open (any string); common categories include constitution, slash_commands, agents, mcps. Environment-config category naming (dev/staging/prod) is Spec 015 scope; Spec 014 makes no commitment.

defaults.description: Default values for the molecule's config_schema.

config_schema.description: Path (molecule-directory-relative) to the molecule's config JSON Schema.

interpreter.description: Program name looked up on PATH (python3, bash, node, ...). spaex verifies existence via shutil.which() before invocation; a missing interpreter is a hook failure subject to on_failure policy.

script.description: Molecule-directory-relative path to the hook script. spaex resolves it against the pinned molecule cache directory; the canonical target must remain inside that directory even through symlinks (path-containment check enforced at execution time on every invocation, including cache hits).

args.description: Additional positional arguments passed after the script. Optional; absent parses to an empty list.

on_failure.description: Failure policy. 'abort' triggers Spec-008 install-transaction rollback on any hook failure (non-zero exit, OSError on launch, missing interpreter on PATH, path-containment failure). 'warn' records hook_status:failed in install.lock and continues, exit 0. Default is 'abort'; the parser MUST set the value explicitly rather than relying on this default metadata.

install_hook.description: Optional side-effect script that spaex install invokes after atom materialization, per molecule in effective-priority order. Runs with cwd = consumer repo root, inherits stdio AND the invoking spaex process's complete environment. Interactive prompts work in TTY environments (the hook may read from stdin, e.g. Python's input()); in non-TTY contexts (CI, piped stdin) input() raises EOFError, so molecule authors must supply a non-interactive fallback path. Side effects are not reversible by spaex remove; spaex remove emits a WARN when removing a molecule that declared install_hook. Consumers can globally opt out for a single invocation via `spaex install --no-install-hooks` or `spaex add --no-install-hooks`.
